translation: <ins>Bujin Wan</ins> (Sinew-Tonifying Pill, 補筋丸): this medicine specifically treats injuries from falls, sprains, and twists, with sinews turned over, sinews cramped, sinews swollen, sinews gathered, bones misaligned, and blood vessels congested and stagnant, with swelling, bruising, and pain and similar conditions. Wujiapi (Acanthopanax), Shechuangzi (Cnidium), good Chenxiang (agarwood), Dingxiang (clove), Chuanniuxi (Achyranthes), Baiyunling (Poria), Bailianrui (white lotus stamen), Roucongrong (Cistanche), Tusizi (Cuscuta), Danggui (Angelica, washed in wine), Shudihuang (cooked Rehmannia), Mudanpi (moutan bark), Xuanmugua (Chaenomeles, one liang each), Huaishanyao (Chinese yam, eight qian), Renshen (ginseng), Guangmuxiang (costus root, three qian each). Grind all together into a fine powder, refine honey into pills the size of a pellet (彈子), each pill weighing three qian, and take with good ash-free wine. <ins>Jiajian Bujin Wan</ins> (Modified Sinew-Tonifying Pill, 加減補筋丸): Danggui (Angelica, one liang), Shudihuang (cooked Rehmannia), Baishaoyao (white peony, two liang each), Honghua (safflower), Ruxiang (frankincense), Baiyunling (Poria), Gusuibu (Drynaria, one liang each), Guangchenpi (tangerine peel, two liang), Moyao (myrrh, three qian), Dingxiang (clove, five qian). Grind all together into a fine powder, refine honey into pills the size of a pellet, each pill weighing three qian, and take with good ash-free wine.
